text: shira's knee op is next tuesday, she's dreading the general anaesthetic. text her the night b4

theo running the half marathon sunday. first one, says his calves are wrecked from training

need to ring mariam tmrw re her mum's hip replacement, think it went ok but she sounded wiped
julia viewing 3 flats in bristol this weekend w her partner andre. andre wants a garden for the dog, julia just wants to be near the station

ava moving to glasgow sometime in the new year for the job at the uni. her brother anders already lives up there so she'll stay w him at first
kofi has a scan next wed. didn't say what for and i didn't push. check in after

aarav coeliac - remember for the leaving do

don't forget andile's 5 a side final is thurs eve, said i'd bring the oranges lol

dentist appt thurs 10am, then car mot
phone the letting agent abt the boiler b4 friday

anders' choir doing a concert in a fortnight at st mary's, he's got a solo and is terrified. should send good luck msg that morning
karim viewing a room in walthamstow tmrw and another sat. fingers crossed
need to get aditi something small for after the exam, she's been on about wanting a new rosin and a proper case cover

caitlin starting at the new hospital as a ward sister in jan. still on nights till xmas tho

moved my viewing to next tues. pack boxes this weekend, ask the agent abt parking permits
omar's cousin omar bianchi (the other omar lol) is a structural engineer, might be useful for the survey

rhys and his girlfriend mia are doing the london marathon in april, both got ballot places. mia's never run more than 10k so she's a bit freaked. rhys has done 3 already and keeps sending her training plans which i don't think is helping lol. they're also running for the hospice that looked after his grandad. need to sponsor them both b4 the end of the month
eva's starting a pottery course tues nights, said it's the only thing keeping her sane atm
hugo said he's ok. he's not ok. ring him sunday

so much on: krisztina's rescheduled recital is the 2nd, theo's race thing the sunday after, and karim's moving day is sometime that wk too. need to sort the car b4 then

chioma's mum asked if i can help w the move to the bungalow next month. she's not really up to lifting after her own op in the summer. told her i'd do the sat. ask chioma what time works and whether her uncle kofi is bringing his van or if we need to hire one

long chat w shira after. op went fine but recovery is slower than she thought, still on crutches and can't drive for 6 wks. her husband is doing the school runs. she's bored out of her mind and fed up of daytime tv. sent her a list of podcasts. should pop round next week w cake, she's mentioned the lemon drizzle from the place on high st
